hypothesis: The local device and pinned software can support faithful fixed-depth Ouro scoring and controlled small-model training.
baseline: Published Ouro-1.4B reference results and a 3-layer single-loop synthetic baseline
intervention: Environment setup and correctness/pilot checks only; later stages receive separate frozen configurations
dataset: Pinned ARC/Winogrande revisions and versioned synthetic prefix arithmetic generator, frozen before use
split: Separate calibration/validation and held-out test; no model selection on test
primary_metric: Correct forward, loss, gradient, cache, and scorer checks
decision_rule: Advance only after numerical correctness and measured resource checks pass
code_revision: Record git HEAD at process start; require clean tracked files
environment: Local NVIDIA V100 32GB; isolated project environment; no native BF16
experiment_commands: Commands will be committed with each runnable stage

version_control.visibility_authorization: Explicit user request for this experiment overrides the workspace private default
